_doc: Copy to ~/.config/claudiverse/host-agent.json (chmod 600) and fill in. Never commit the real one.
host_token: <this machine's host token: Accounts.create_host_token(user, name) on the server>
seat_token: <the ordinary seat token this machine's seats already use (CLAUDIVERSE_TOKEN)>
name: <optional; defaults to the hostname. Must equal the CLAUDIVERSE_HOST this machine's seats report>
bin: <optional: the claude binary for spawned seats; default is cv-spawn's>
spawn_runtime: <optional: a name under runtimes (e.g. stock+mod) that the app's New seat and resume start on, in place of bin>
spawn_pooled: <optional: true = the app's New seat and resume send model calls through the server's account pool (--pooled)>
mcp: <optional: an MCP config for spawned seats, e.g. one giving them the claudiverse cv_* tools>
_relay: Optional: the local relay for a plain `claude` (loopback only). Point the shell at it with claude-relay.zsh / claude-relay.bash, never with settings.json env (that overrides every seat's own routing).
_profiles: What a seat profile may choose on this machine. runtimes: name -> the binary it runs (absolute) and the Claude Code version it is (shown in the desktop); "pool_only": true when this machine has no Claude Code login of its own, so its seats run on the server's account pool. modes: a subset of default, acceptEdits, plan, auto (bypassPermissions is never allowed). MCP servers come from ~/.config/claudiverse/mcp-catalog.json ({"mcpServers": {name: entry}}), or mcp_catalog to put it elsewhere.
